bio: Savour a slice of tradition with an afternoon tea for two at Vinteas by Beaumont Patisserie in Leamington Spa. Enjoy bottomless prosecco for 90 minutes!  Vinteas by Beaumont Patisserie is a vintage tearoom in Leamington Spa. Celebrate a special occasion or simply add a touch of style to your next shopping trip spent with a friend. Tuck into a scrumptious afternoon tea for two. Enjoy tempting finger sandwiches, delicious mini quiche, indulgent mini cakes and fruit or plain fluffy scones beautifully layered with clotted cream and strawberry preserve. Sip on either a cup of tea or coffee while indulging your sweet tooth with this assortment of mouth-watering treats.
